findings.text: the sample reads "sixty signals ... fifteen per credited source, or every such signal where a source is credited for fewer, a hand reading against that source with the count of values that agree", but under this version's own rule credit attaches to a value ("for each value a signal has exactly one outcome ... credited to the first such source"), not to a signal: one signal can be credited to the linked row for its quantity, the archive for its unit and the pattern for its role, so it belongs to three of the four source groups, "fifteen per credited source" does not yield sixty signals, and a signal read "against that source" carries values that source never decided — the only quality control in the section can then charge a disagreement to a source that gave nothing, and the "at most one value in twenty read" tolerance has no defined denominator
